cohort: A single neonate born to a mother with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) was studied.
finding: Genomic analysis of SARS-CoV-2 from the mother and neonate showed identical sequences except for 1 nucleotide, indicating probable vertical transmission of SARS-CoV-2.
mod_finding: Despite delivery via cesarean section and initial negative tests, the neonate tested positive for SARS-CoV-2 on day 3 and developed symptoms on day 5.
